test_operator_overloading: run the pybind11 test_operator_overloading test to verify Vector2 arithmetic operators like add, subtract, multiply, and divide
test_operators_notimplemented: run the pybind11 test_operators_notimplemented test to verify cross-type operator behavior returns NotSupported correctly
test_nested: run the pybind11 test_nested test to verify operator overloading on nested class structures like NestA, NestB, NestC
test_overriding_eq_reset_hash: run the pybind11 test_overriding_eq_reset_hash test to verify equality override resets hash to unhashable
test_return_set_of_unhashable: run the pybind11 test_return_set_of_unhashable test to verify TypeError is raised for unhashable types in sets
